The universal bound on convolution perturbations gives the remaining linear upper bound. All quantifiers and zero-factor limits were checked. Exact code tests are supplementary, not used to infer an infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The 2026 Flores theorem identifies nonabelian and infinite-order negative cases, explicitly reserving infinite torsion abelian groups for the global problem. The 2017 Draga-Kania dense-invertibles condition does not imply open multiplication, and the 2024 Kania-Maslany sufficient theorem is under separate norm-controlled inversion/duality hypotheses; neither statement entails sharp local aperture orders for finite Fourier factors in the ambient torsion group algebra. The published primary full texts and mathematical research index were queried for local openness, finite spectrum and idempotent aliases. The theorem rules out every locally non-open witness containing even one finitely supported group-algebra factor, and completely determines the natural local openness exponent of every doubly finite-support pair by one intrinsic spectral test.
